mapper.select: select cr.id, cr.user_coupon_id as userCouponId, cr.batch_id as batchId, cb.name as batchName, cr.scene, cr.note, cr.redeemed_at as redeemedAt from coupon_redemption cr inner join coupon_batch cb on cb.id = cr.batch_id where cr.user_id = #{userId} order by cr.redeemed_at desc, cr.id desc
